arm_schedule: generation first, with control/local/modulated run serially on one device

world.context: independent, equal probability A and B
world.maps: two private permutations per actor, conflicting for every raw symbol

revisit_pairing: per actor and raw symbol, after BOTH contexts have been presented, pair the kth subsequent A with the kth subsequent B; never expose pairs to the policy

plasticity.control: archived directed first-legal receipt rule and support schedule
plasticity.local: evolved local per-tick weights, biases, gate evidence and gradual support
plasticity.modulated: same local equations with signed receiving-node activity/trace gain
plasticity.precision: FP16 effective recurrent weights and dynamics, FP32 accumulation; local and modulated also accumulate slow parameter changes in FP32

warm_start.selection: Historical rank by island on committed final-generation rows; reconstruct birth state from the saved plan and previous-generation parents; skip SHA-256 duplicates across all destination islands.

founder_control: one initial plan and identical birth tensors across the three arms
inheritance: only birth graph, rule coefficients, and scalar parameters; reset lifetime state per actor

breeding.selection_rule: sample one mutant uniformly; on the current development tape accept with min(1, exp((mutant_score - exact_parent_score) / temperature))
breeding.initial_branch_rule: take the strongest remaining candidate from each founder family in rank order before giving any family another slot
breeding.ordinary_breeding_rule: all scored offspring are eligible for ordinary selection; rank-eligible protected parents may also mate in the ordinary pool, but their exact retest is reserved
breeding.refresh_rule: stagger by island and slot; prefer an unrepresented founder family in the rank shortlist, then maximize birth-arc mask distance from the outgoing branch; defer if no probe has a new mask

perturbation.budget: replace two ordinary local lanes per pair; both eligible for selection
perturbation.directions: seeded symmetric coefficient directions, independent of development scores

holdout: evaluate every island's development winner on paired unseen worlds; no feedback to breeding
